content.short: Unit is the asset tokenization layer on Hyperliquid, handling deposits and withdrawals of external assets.
content.description: Unit brings outside assets such as Bitcoin onto Hyperliquid as spot tokens, handling the deposit and withdrawal path in both directions. It is the mechanism by which non-EVM assets become tradeable on HyperCore's order books rather than only through wrapped representations issued elsewhere. For a venue whose main draw is its order book, the range of assets Unit supports directly shapes what can be traded there.
